content.title: About
content.content: Mixed nuts, unroasted (2270) is a blend of various nuts such as almonds, hazelnuts, cashews, walnuts, peanuts and others, combined in balanced proportions. The nuts are not heat‑treated, preserving their natural flavor, aroma and the maximum amount of nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mixed nuts are often used in cooking to add texture and flavor to dishes.
Unroasted nuts retain more vitamins and antioxidants compared with roasted ones.
The blend typically contains about 50 % healthy fats by weight.
Some mixes include dried fruit or seeds, increasing their nutritional value.
Mixed nuts are usually sold in airtight packaging to prevent oil oxidation.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: The blend provides monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fatty acids that support heart and vascular health.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Nuts supply quality protein that aids tissue repair and helps maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Contains vitamin E and B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamin E is a powerful antioxidant, while B‑vitamins participate in energy metabolism.

items.title: Packed with minerals
items.content: Magnesium, phosphorus, zinc and copper in the mix are essential for bones, nervous system and immunity.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The dietary fiber in nuts promotes healthy bowel function and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Tree nut allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions, ranging from mild symptoms to anaphylaxis.

items.title: High in calories
items.content: Nuts are energy‑dense, so portion size should be monitored, especially on calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Whole nuts can pose a choking risk for young children; finely chopped or ground nuts are safer.

items.title: Oxalate content
items.content: Certain nuts (e.g., almonds) contain oxalates, which may contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mixed nuts can be enjoyed as a snack, added to granola, yogurt, salads, baked goods, or used in sauces. Soaking the nuts for a few hours can improve digestibility and soften the skins.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the mix in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. For longer shelf life keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent fat oxidation. Discard nuts that smell rancid or have off‑flavors.
